messages.subject: R square
parts:

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: R square
parts:
I looked at some other regression examples, and the blavaan R2 matches lavaan pretty closely. Also, blavaan gets its R2 values by calling lavaan code, so I'm not convinced there is a bug here.

In your case, I think the difference comes from the estimated variance of BMD, which is .062 for blavaan and .010 for lavaan. In other words, blavaan thinks that BMD has more variance to explain, so the percentage of explained variance is lower. I am guessing that this can be traced back to the prior on the variance of BMD. The default is gamma(1,.5), which maybe isn't so great for such small variances. You might look at prior sensitivity here.

Ed
